description: This file defines an interface 'AutoCloseableSlf4jLogger' that extends the SLF4J Logger and Java's AutoCloseable. It provides methods to manage correlation IDs and MDC entries for logging, supporting resource management and contextual logging enhancements.

classes.name: AutoCloseableSlf4jLogger
classes.description: An interface combining SLF4J Logger capabilities with AutoCloseable, allowing management of MDC entries and correlation IDs.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID for log operations until discarded, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the previously set correlation ID from MDC.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into MDC for the logger, enabling contextual information in logs.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes a specified key from MDC, cleaning up diagnostic context.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Implements resource cleanup, as the interface extends AutoCloseable.
